title: ENG-11018: Make the cloud CLI agent-usable (--json everywhere, non-interactive off a TTY, --follow opt-in)
author: amsraman

unresolved.first_comment: P2 Report error deployment statuses as unsuccessful: when the API returns a failure status such as `build error` (contains `error` but not `failed`), the JSON path in apps.py:392 reports "success": true; use the same failure predicates as watch_deployment_status.

P1: When fetching the selected project fails, `--json` produces no document and still returns success because the broad exception handler swallows the error (project.py:207). Emit the JSON error result and a nonzero exit.

P1: When the invite endpoint returns an error detail without the word `failed`, this JSON branch reports `invited: true` and exits successfully (project.py:109). Detect the hosting error structurally.

P1: When `get_deployment_status` returns an error status such as `build error`, "success": "failed" not in status reports success (apps.py:392). Reuse the same failure predicate as `watch_deployment_status`.

P2: When stdout is reserved, a record carrying `extra={"progress": progress}` still replaces the reserved console with `progress.console` (reflex-base log.py:205). Route progress-bound records through the reserved stderr console.
P2: When `--json` deletes a missing app, `delete_app` exits from the not-found branches without emitting a document (apps.py:643). Emit a `deleted: false` payload before those exits.
P2: When `get_app_logs` returns `[]` after a request or decoding failure, this branch reports `error: null` as if no logs existed (apps.py:779). Preserve an error signal for those failure paths.

P2: The new --json output hardcodes "deleted": True instead of reflecting the actual server response (secrets.py:236); a 404/400 detail such as "secret not found" reports a deleted secret with exit code 0.
P2: In --json mode, when rollback/describe fail, the command raises Exit(1) before reaching the `if as_json:` block, so stdout stays empty (apps.py:202). Emit a document on the failure path too.
P3: This fragment is filed as `.feature` even though the change is breaking (default interactivity and JSON/output semantics change); rename to `+eng-11018-agent-friendly-cli.breaking.md`.
